## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Monolithic scope creep and massive PR found (+540 additions over 14 files).

## FINDINGS
This PR bundles four completely unrelated architectural and component changes: Dashboard lazy loading, Blog/Resources error state boundaries, Contact console refactoring, and Research routing tweaks. This violates our strict project scoping rules. Please decouple this PR into 4 standalone, distinct pull requests.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: The React.lazy and Suspense boundaries for dashboard components are excellent performance optimizations, but they must be isolated into their own dedicated PR.
